title: Rosenthal map of metal AM
heading: Hundreds of process windows, two dimensionless numbers
boundary: R = R̄: melt pool as wide as required
pool: Melt pool from above, Rosenthal isotherm
label: Log–log map of %n literature operating conditions of metal additive manufacturing in dimensionless velocity and power. Selected: %m by %p, aspect ratio %a.
caption: Each point is a published operating condition, made dimensionless with the Rosenthal moving-point-source solution: alloys and machines collapse onto one plane. Lines of constant aspect ratio A_r run diagonally; below the white curve the melt pool is narrower than the required half-width R̄. Select a point for its melt-pool shape.
provenance: From the literature review behind Moda, Chiocca et al., Materials & Design 223 (2022) 110991 (updated dataset, revision 5): %n operating conditions of SLM and LMD with the thermophysical properties used.
